aggregation_order: spatial zone statistics first, temporal zonal-median features second
block_scope: local to one invocation; namespace by input hashes and configuration

block_id.description: Increasing local ID of a contiguous compatible history block.

delta.description: Current minus previous zonal median; null if either is unavailable.

delta_seconds.description: Actual elapsed seconds between last two profiles; null on warmup.

dts_id.description: Source/device identifier, physical meaning not assumed.

history_count.description: Available profiles in this block, at most H.

history_end.description: Current measurement, not proof of online availability.

history_ready.description: H profiles available; this does not guarantee zone quality.

history_sources.description: Actual history current-first, without padded sources.

history_start.description: Oldest available measurement in current history.

index_start.description: Absolute first original point index, inclusive.

lag_medians.description: Current-first, fixed H; null for missing/padded medians.

line_number.description: 1-based physical start line in source CSV.

maximum.description: Maximum of current zone's usable original values.

maximum_minus_median.description: Upper spatial excursion; retains narrow peaks.

median.description: Median of current zone's usable original values.

median_minus_minimum.description: Lower spatial excursion; retains narrow dips.

minimum.description: Minimum of current zone's usable original values.

nominal_count.description: Configured zone width, including a partial final zone.

point_count.description: Actual coordinate count in this zone.

quality_flags.description: Unique quality codes, never event labels.

rate.description: delta / delta_seconds in unknown y units per second.

rolling_mean.description: Equal-weight mean of usable medians in the complete H window.

rolling_std.description: Population std of usable medians in the complete H window.

schema_version.description: Versioned proposal contract, not an approved team contract.

selected_grid_sha256.description: SHA256 of selected float64 x bytes, not a physical line ID.

sentinel_count.description: Masked point count: sentinel_mask or original y == -300.

sentinel_fraction.description: sentinel_count / point_count; not probability of failure.

source_file.description: Source CSV path supplied to ingestion.

std.description: Population spatial std (ddof=0), not a temporal std.

temporal_valid_count.description: Usable zonal medians in available history.

timestamp.description: Current measurement ISO datetime; naive time remains naive.

timezone_known.description: Whether current measurement has a known offset.

timezone_raw.description: Original timezone offset suffix, if known.

utc_offset_seconds.description: Known UTC offset seconds; null is not UTC.

valid_count.description: Available original y samples after suspect-value masking.

valid_fraction.description: valid_count / nominal_count; geometry and mask both affect it.

x_end.description: Coordinate of last actual point in zone, not a room boundary.

x_start.description: Coordinate of first actual point in zone; physical units unknown.

zone_id.description: 0-based zone ordinal inside configured selected slice.

missing_policy: null; raw suspect values masked before spatial aggregation
